items.question: What threefold classification applies to the ritual bathing of the deity?
premises: Ritual bathing may be performed as a daily observance.
Ritual bathing may be performed on specific occasions.
Ritual bathing may be performed to fulfill a desired aim.
items.inference: Therefore ritual bathing is considered threefold.
items.plain_english: Daily, occasional, and desire-driven bathing is considered to be of three kinds.
